title: Madoka Magica’s Big Film Trilogy Is Going to Be Easier to Watch Than Ever
content: After more than 12 years, the film trilogy of Puella Magi Madoka Magica will officially be streaming on Netflix. The films were originally released in 2012 and 2013, and now the official X handle of Netflix Anime has confirmed the platform will be adding these movies to its library next year.
author: ComicBook

title: The Remarried Empress to Make Anime Debut With Crunchyroll in 2027 – Watch First Look Trailer
content: The Remarried Empress is finally getting an anime adaptation after its controversial light novel and manhwa. The webtoon industry is on the rise thanks to several anime adaptations.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Anime of 2026 That Are the Perfect Replacements for Solo Leveling Fans
content: Solo Leveling has emerged as one of the leading anime franchises in the industry since its debut in 2024. By adapting the famous webcomic, the anime introduced fans to what made the series so popular as a manhwa.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece Just Set Up Another Dive Into the Most Tragic Straw Hat’s Painful Past For a Good Reason
content: One Piece is currently depicting the Elbaph arc, which has reached a crucial stage in its climax, positioning the Straw Hats to evolve and gain new power upgrades to confront the new villains.
author: ComicBook

title: Killing Bites Manga Publishes 1st Part of Final Chapter
content: Sentai Filmworks licensed the television anime adaptation of the manga, and it describes the story: By the time Yuya Nomoto discovers his so-called friends have duped him into a clandestine plot to kidnap a high school girl, they're already dead.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Won’t Be as “New” as Fans Might Want
content: Dragon Ball Super has returned after eight years with a new remake anime series , but one star revealed that this new anime unfortunately won’t be as “new” as fans are hoping for. Dragon Ball Super ‘s original TV anime made its debut over a decade ago, and it’s been eight years since the Tournament of Power.
author: ComicBook

title: Heavy Metal Band Lovebites Suspend Live Performances for 2027
content: The band plan to return with live performances in 2028. Lovebites consist of five members (pictured right from left to right): guitarist Midori, bassist Fami, vocalist Asami, drummer Haruna, and guitarist/keyboardist Miyako. The band started in 2016.
author: ANN

title: Osamu Tezuka's Phoenix Manga's Future Arc Gets Stage Play in February
content: Osamu Tezuka 's Phoenix ( Hi no Tori ) manga is inspiring another stage play that will run at Sakura Hall in Shibuya Cultural Centre Owada in Tokyo from February 6-8. The play Hi no Tori Mirai-hen ZEROMDISTANCE ( Phoenix Future Arc ZEROMDISTANCE) adapts the manga's "Future" arc.
author: ANN

title: Kagurabachi Confirms End Date for Anime World Tour With Final Stops Revealed
content: Kagurabachi has been in the midst of a world tour where the anime has been sharing the first episode before anywhere else, and now a date has been set for its grand finale with the final stops on the tour revealed.
author: ComicBook

title: Texas' Kawacon Anime, Gaming Convention Ends After 5 Years
content: The staff of the convention did not announce a reason but did make a statement: To our Kawacon family, After much consideration and with heavy hearts, we have made the difficult decision to cease Kawacon operations for the foreseeable future.
author: ANN
